components.source: ISO 4762:2004 (confirmed 2023) (Hexagon socket head cap screws); https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/ISO/4762/ (full Table 1 and Table 2 ls/lg); https://fasten.it/Norms/Norm/DIN_EN_ISO_4762 (DIN EN ISO 4762:2004 table: P, dk, k, s, t, w, b; mass table for length range); https://www.globalfastener.com/standards/detail_1737.html (ISO 4762-2004: P, dk, da, ds, e, k, s, t, w) | some sizes: DIN 912:1983-12 (withdrawn; earlier editions 1933-10 ... 1979-09) (Hexagon socket head cap screws (Zylinderschrauben mit Innensechskant)); https://bolt.msk.ru/standards/DIN%20EN%20ISO%204762.pdf (DIN EN ISO 4762:2004-06 full text: Tabelle 1 values and length ranges used for M1.6-M64; national foreword lists DIN 912:1983-12 as predecessor and the 2004 s-tolerance change for s=1.5/2); https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/DIN/912/ (local copy /root/skb-scratch/dl/fe/din912.html; identical to its ISO 4762 page https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/ISO/4762/ - all values agree with ISO 4762:2004); https://ferrofast.com/resources/dimensional-standards/din/screws/din-912/ (DIN 912 table incl. M1.4/M18/M22/M27/M33: dk min/max(knurled), k min/max, s min/max, t); https://www.wegertseder.com/Download/techdat/DIN-912-Zylinderschrauben-mit-Innensechskant.pdf and https://www.schrauben-lexikon.de/norm/DIN_912.asp (nominal dk, k, s incl. M1.4, M18, M22, M27, M33); https://www.birkhofer-shop.com/WebRoot/Sage/Shops/BirkhoferVerbindungselemente/MediaGallery/TechData/DIN_912.pdf (nominal dk, k, s, b M1.6-M20 incl. M14, M18); https://www.ottoroth.de/media/docs/download/web_handbuch_din_en_iso.pdf (Otto Roth "Normenumstellung DIN >>> EN und ISO" handbook p.31: DIN 912 -> ISO 4762 changes); https://media.wuerth.com/stmedia/wuerth/documents/documents/LANG_de/18902376.pdf (Wuerth Normteile 2018: "ISO 4762 ersetzt DIN 912. Es besteht Austauschbarkeit - Nennmassbereich geaendert - Feingewinde in ISO 12474 ueberfuehrt"); https://www.haberkorn.com/kataloge/umstellung-din-auf-iso-uebersicht-verbindungselemente/files/assets/common/downloads/publication.pdf (DIN 912 1983-12 -> ISO 4762, nominal range changed)
